details: I would like to ask if it possible to add a new video website bilibili.com in the whitelist of VRC Video Player? It is hard to use youtube.com for Chinese players, and I noticed that there is another Chinese video website youku.com, however, youku.com is not focus on ACG fans. By contrast, bilibili.com is a better place to enjoy ACG videos. As a result, I hope the VRC Video Player can support bilibili.com officially.
title: Can bilibili.com be added into whitelist of VRC Video Player?
